name: Neural diffuse albedo
definition: An 8-layer MLP that outputs the diffuse albedo (rho_d) for a point x, given inputs of 3D coordinate x, surface normal n, and geometric features f.
summary: Neural diffuse albedo predicts spatially-varying diffuse reflectance using an MLP that takes coordinates, normals, and geometric features, distinguished by its specific input composition and higher-frequency positional encoding.
